observation.name: Osmosis
observation.rules: Eight rounds numbered 1..8. Allocate 10000 in hundreds, minimum100 per ally. Orders simultaneous; rivals commit first from prior public state. One edge per round; gates use round+phase. Powered moves cost1; over-budget powered allied orders all stay. Higher group wins under +1, lower positive group under -1; tie0; transfer min(1000,loser). Polarity reverses at authenticated round. Cache+500 once; base raid1000 once; no resurrection. At round8: >=2 active allies, >=11000 points, strictly beat rivals, active authorized ally at open exit, collect a cache and win a post-amendment transfer; then settle.
